title: JFK on the Harvard astronomy department's board of overseers

tellings.quote: JFK was the on the board of overseers for the astronomer department.

plain: In the 1950s, John F. Kennedy, the future president, is said to have sat on the board of overseers, a governing board, for Harvard's astronomy department. The astronomer Beatriz Villarroel tells this from the notes of Stanton Friedman, a UFO researcher. It comes up alongside a story that the Harvard astronomer Donald Menzel was caught destroying photographic plates of the sky, and would tie Kennedy to that department.
